category.name: SMS and messaging apps
category.description: Send and receive SMS and messages on WhatsApp, LINE or Telegram through a messaging provider's API.

entries.name: AWS End User Messaging SMS
entries.auth_hint: AWS Signature Version 4 with IAM credentials (use an AWS SDK or CLI: aws pinpoint-sms-voice-v2 send-text-message)
entries.free_tier: Paid only; US SMS $0.00774/message + $0.00421 carrier fee (10DLC or toll-free)
entries.desc_en: Send SMS, MMS and voice messages and manage sender numbers, opt-outs and registrations via the AWS SMS and Voice v2 API.
entries.notes: New accounts start in a sandbox: $1/month spend limit, up to 10 verified destination numbers. Production access needs an AWS Support case (reviewed, about 24 h). US sending needs a registered 10DLC or toll-free number. SendTextMessage defaults to 1 request/s per region. The AWS MCP Server is generic (calls any AWS API).

auth_scheme.format: AWS SigV4-signed request (Authorization: AWS4-HMAC-SHA256 Credential=...) to sms-voice.<region>.amazonaws.com

rate_limits.summary: SendTextMessage 1 request/s per region by default (raisable); 1 msg/s per recipient; sandbox $1/month spend

sms.price_pl: $0.03222 per outbound SMS to Poland (USD, all networks, all number types)
sms.sender_registration: US: no sender IDs; you must request and register a US number (10DLC, toll-free or short code). Poland: sender IDs and long codes supported, no registration flagged. UK, Spain, India etc. require sender ID registration
sms.trial_limits: Sandbox: only to verified destination numbers (max 10), $1.00/month SMS spend limit (and $1 MMS); production access via AWS Support case per Region (first response within 24 h)

uptime.up_means: host reachable: HTTP < 500, even 401/404; not a test of any endpoint

entries.name: Bird (formerly MessageBird)
entries.auth_hint: Authorization: Bearer bk_<region>_... workspace API key (dashboard), or OAuth 2.0 user token (auth code + PKCE or device flow)
entries.free_tier: Paid only; prepaid wallet, US long code or toll-free $0.0035/SMS + carrier fees
entries.desc_en: Send SMS, email and WhatsApp messages, verify phone numbers and track delivery via REST API or hosted MCP.
entries.notes: SMS draws on a prepaid wallet (402 if empty). Destination countries are default-deny except your home country; enable more in the dashboard. US long codes need 10DLC registration; the US has no alphanumeric senders. Hosted MCP uses OAuth; a local stdio MCP runs via the bird CLI (bird mcp).

rate_limits.summary: Per-organization regional policies (e.g. sms_send); quota in RateLimit-Policy header; 429 with Retry-After

async_jobs.how: POST /v1/sms/messages returns 202 Accepted with a message id; final status via webhooks or GET

call.async: Returns 202 Accepted; track delivery via GET https://{region}.platform.bird.com/v1/sms/messages/{message_id} (or /events) or webhooks
call.example: curl -X POST https://us1.platform.bird.com/v1/sms/messages -H "Authorization: Bearer $BIRD_API_KEY" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"to": "+14155550100", "text": "Your order shipped"}'

sms.price_pl: $0.035 per message segment to Poland (USD; alphanumeric, long code or short code; toll-free not published)
sms.sender_registration: US long codes need 10DLC brand + campaign registration; toll-free needs verification; US accepts no alphanumeric senders. Poland: alphanumeric, long code and short code need no registration

uptime.up_means: host reachable: HTTP < 500, even 401/404; not a test of any endpoint

entries.name: LINE Messaging API
entries.auth_hint: Authorization: Bearer <CHANNEL_ACCESS_TOKEN> (issued for the Messaging API channel in LINE Developers Console)
entries.free_tier: Free Communication plan (Japan): 200 push/broadcast messages/month; reply messages are unlimited. Beyond that only paid plans (Light JPY 5,000 for 5,000 messages, Standard JPY 15,000 for 30,000). Free quotas vary by region
entries.desc_en: Lets an agent send and reply to messages, rich messages and broadcasts to users of a LINE Official Account and read user profiles.
entries.notes: Requires a LINE Official Account and a Messaging API channel. MCP server is local (stdio, npx @line/line-bot-mcp-server) with channel token and user ID env vars.

call.example: curl -X POST https://api.line.me/v2/bot/message/push -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "Authorization: Bearer $LINE_CHANNEL_ACCESS_TOKEN" -d '{"to":"<LINE_USER_ID>","messages":[{"type":"text","text":"Hello, world"}]}'

unit_price.summary: Japan Standard plan (JPY 15,000/mo incl. 30,000 messages): additional push messages up to JPY 3 each, counted per recipient; reply messages are free

uptime.up_means: host reachable: HTTP < 500, even 401/404; not a test of any endpoint

entries.name: Sinch
entries.auth_hint: Access key ID + secret (dashboard > Access keys): HTTP Basic, or exchange at https://auth.sinch.com/oauth2/token (client credentials) for a Bearer token
entries.free_tier: Trial: free trial credit and a free test number on signup, no card; then paid (US 10DLC $0.0078/SMS + carrier fees)
entries.desc_en: Send and receive SMS (and WhatsApp, RCS and other channels) via the Conversation REST API.
entries.notes: The standalone SMS API is only for existing customers; new accounts send SMS through the Conversation API with an SMS channel. The trial test number can only text your own verified numbers. US A2P needs 10DLC or toll-free registration. MCP server (npm @sinch/mcp) is a developer preview, run locally or self-hosted.

free_plan.quota: Trial credit and one free test number on signup

auth_scheme.format: Authorization: Basic base64(<KEY_ID>:<KEY_SECRET>) (or Bearer <token> from OAuth2 client credentials)

rate_limits.summary: 800 requests/s per project; app queue drains to channel at 20 msg/s by default; 429 when exceeded

call.operation: send an SMS via the Conversation API
call.async: delivery status arrives as a webhook callback to the app's callback URL

unit_price.summary: US SMS (10DLC or toll-free): $0.0078 per outbound message, plus carrier fees

sms.sender_registration: US 10DLC needs a registered brand and a 10DLC campaign; toll-free numbers need TFN verification. Sender ID registration is recommended/required per country (details in dashboard Country Information)
sms.trial_limits: Trial credit on signup, no card; one free test number (buy numbers after testing); sandbox sends are simulated and only to phone numbers you have already verified

entries.name: Telegram Bot API
entries.free_tier: free, no key needed beyond a bot token from @BotFather
entries.desc_en: Send/receive messages, media, and inline interactions via a simple HTTPS bot API.
entries.notes: No single official SDK (community libraries only); a self-hosted local Bot API server option removes some file-size limits. Listed MCP server uses a user account via Telethon/MTProto (API_ID/API_HASH + session string from my.telegram.org), not the bot token.

rate_limits.summary: ~1 message/s per chat, 20 messages/min per group, ~30 messages/s for bulk; paid broadcasts up to 1,000/s

entries.name: Telnyx
entries.auth_hint: Authorization: Bearer <TELNYX_API_KEY> (Mission Control Portal > API Keys)
entries.free_tier: Trial: $5 test credit, 1 verified number, 100 messages/day; then paid (US 10DLC $0.004/SMS part + carrier fees)
entries.desc_en: Send and receive SMS, MMS, RCS and WhatsApp messages and manage phone numbers via REST API.
entries.notes: US A2P messaging needs 10DLC registration; US long-code throughput is set per 10DLC campaign. Default send rates: long code 0.1 msg/s (non-US), toll-free 20 msg/s per number. Agents can sign up via a bot-challenge flow (telnyx.com/agent-signup.md).

rate_limits.summary: Send rate per sender: long code 0.1 msg/s (non-US), toll-free 20 msg/s, short code 1,000 msg/s; excess is queued

async_jobs.how: Send is queued; delivery progress and final status arrive via messaging webhooks

call.async: final delivery status arrives via webhook (or GET /v2/messages/{id})

sms.price_pl: $0.037 per outbound SMS part to Poland (same rate for all listed Polish operators)
sms.sender_registration: US: 10DLC needs brand + campaign (TCR) registration; toll-free needs verification; alphanumeric not supported in US/CA. Poland: alphanumeric sender ID supported and preserved, no registration
sms.trial_limits: Trial: $5 testing credit; SMS only to 1 verified number, long code only, max 100 messages/day, 1 messaging profile
sms.countries: full list: https://telnyx.com/pricing.md (Messaging Outbound rate deck, 227 country codes)

uptime.up_means: host reachable: HTTP < 500, even 401/404; not a test of any endpoint

entries.name: Textbelt
entries.auth_hint: A key sent in the 'key' form field: the shared free key 'textbelt' (1 SMS/day, no signup) or a paid key bought with a one-time card payment at https://textbelt.com/purchase/; appending '_test' to a key validates a request without sending.
entries.free_tier: Free: shared key 'textbelt' sends 1 SMS per day; paid credits are a one-time purchase
entries.notes: SMS containing URLs need extra permission. Senders must identify their business; recurring messages need opt-out text (added by Textbelt). Reply webhooks for US numbers only. Use E.164 numbers. Delivery status for 1 week at /status/{textId}; remaining credits at /quota/{key}. Not for bulk or unsolicited messaging.
entries.desc_en: Send an SMS to a phone number (US or international) with one HTTP POST, and check delivery status and remaining credits.

rate_limits.summary: Free key: 1 SMS/day; paid keys limited by purchased credits

call.example: curl -X POST https://textbelt.com/text --data-urlencode phone="$PHONE_E164" --data-urlencode message="Hello from my agent" -d key="$TEXTBELT_KEY"

entries.name: Twilio
entries.auth_hint: Basic auth: AccountSID:AuthToken (or API Key SID:Secret)

config.note: Alpha server from Twilio Labs that calls the Twilio API (e.g. send SMS); credentials are passed as the last argument. Twilio also hosts https://mcp.twilio.com/docs, which only searches documentation and cannot send messages.

entries.free_tier: Trial: 100 SMS, 100 WhatsApp, 3,000 emails, 75 voice minutes; no card; one-time, expires after 30 days; SMS only to verified numbers within the signup country, using predefined templates
entries.desc_en: Send/receive SMS, WhatsApp messages, and voice calls programmatically via REST API.
entries.notes: Trial accounts can only message verified numbers; US SMS at scale requires A2P 10DLC registration. Hosted MCP is read-only docs/API-spec search; the executing server is Twilio Labs' npm @twilio-alpha/mcp (alpha).

free_plan.quota: 100 SMS, 100 WhatsApp messages, 3,000 emails, 75 voice minutes; 30 days; verified numbers in the signup country only, predefined templates

call.async: status starts as queued; poll GET .../Messages/{sid}.json or set StatusCallback

unit_price.summary: SMS to Poland: $0.0457 per outbound segment (mobile numbers and alphanumeric sender IDs); $0.001 fee per failed message

sms.price_pl: $0.0457 per outbound SMS segment to Poland (mobile numbers); inbound $0.0075/segment; $0.001 fee per failed message
sms.sender_registration: US: 10DLC needs A2P brand + campaign registration; toll-free numbers cannot send to US/CA until verified. Poland: alphanumeric sender ID supported, no pre-registration; numeric IDs overwritten
sms.trial_limits: Trial: only to up to 5 verified numbers, only within sign-up country, pre-defined templates only (no custom bodies), trial number as sender, 100 free SMS, expires after 30 days

entries.name: Vonage API
entries.auth_hint: API key+secret for SMS/Number Insight; JWT bearer token for Voice/Video APIs
entries.free_tier: Trial: free credit on signup, no credit card required; then pay-as-you-go per request
entries.desc_en: Send SMS, make voice calls, and build video apps via a unified communications REST API.
entries.notes: Auth method differs per sub-API (API key/secret vs JWT), which agents must account for.

auth_scheme.format: Authorization: Basic base64(API_KEY:API_SECRET) (SMS etc.) or Authorization: Bearer <JWT> (Voice, Video, Messages)

call.async: messages[0].status "0" means accepted; delivery receipts arrive via webhook

unit_price.summary: SMS to Poland: $0.04843 per outbound message

sms.price_pl: $0.04843 per outbound SMS to Poland (per message); inbound $0.01091
sms.sender_registration: US: alphanumeric not allowed; use registered 10DLC, toll-free or short code (10DLC mandatory once account leaves trial). Poland: alphanumeric generally supported, no registration stated; generic IDs (INFO, SMS) prohibited
sms.trial_limits: Trial: EUR 2 free credit; SMS only to your registered number + 4 verified test numbers; '[FREE SMS DEMO, TEST MESSAGE]' appended; trial credit cannot buy virtual numbers

entries.name: WhatsApp Business Cloud API
entries.free_tier: Free: non-template (service) messages inside an open 24h customer service window; template messages billed per message (per-message pricing since 2025-07-01)
entries.desc_en: Send/receive WhatsApp messages, template messages, and media programmatically via Graph API.
entries.notes: Requires Meta Business verification and pre-approved message templates for outbound marketing/utility messages outside the 24h session window.

free_plan.quota: Non-template messages inside an open 24h customer service window are free; template messages billed per message

rate_limits.summary: Up to 80 messages/s per business phone number by default (upgradable)

call.async: delivery and read status arrive later via webhooks

unit_price.summary: Non-template messages inside an open customer service window are free; template messages are charged per delivered message at rates by category and recipient country (rate cards linked on page)
